data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'sud', meaning 'help'. Aisooda is a name of a compassionate and caring individual, always ready to lend a helping hand. The name Aisooda carries the meaning “Helpful one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
